Summary: GET /v1/widgets/{id} for an unknown id now returns 404 instead of 500. Added TestWidgetNotFound. The logging format change in this branch was reverted.
wrong:
fix: return 405 for unknown widgets

handlers/widgets.go checks ErrNotFound for /v1/widgets/{id}.

fix: unknown widget ids

Returns 404 on /v1/widgets/{id} and changes the logging format.
correct_alts:
fix: return 404 for unknown widget ids

GET /v1/widgets/{id} answered 500 when the widget was missing. handlers/widgets.go now maps ErrNotFound to 404.

fix: map ErrNotFound to a 404 response

In handlers/widgets.go a missing widget at /v1/widgets/{id} is a client error and no longer a server error.
